MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The compact Anker USB hub fits my history of buying adapters and connection accessories, and its four ports offer a practical amount of expansion.",
    "The Ethernet cables and tablet stand connect to needs reflected in my earlier purchases, so I can see why they were suggested even though I would not choose them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming device, television, e-reader and smart speaker introduce activities I have not shown a current interest in; buying computer accessories does not mean I want these devices.",
    "The ten-port hub and six-pack of short Ethernet cables serve relevant purposes, but their scale and specific setup requirements do not fit a need I currently have.",
    "The gaming mouse pad and internal hard drive assume gaming or storage needs that my connection accessories do not establish."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in a few electronics accessories seems to have been stretched into an interest in electronics generally.",
    "An earlier purchase seems to be treated as a reason to buy more related equipment, even when it may already have solved that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The recurring link across my purchases is practical connectivity and compatibility, especially USB, networking and display connections.",
    "A relevant purpose is only part of my decision: port count, cable length, pack size and the need for separate power determine whether an accessory is useful now.",
    "I buy infrequently, so a loose connection to an old purchase is not enough to make me choose something today."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognize my interest in connectivity accessories but stretch it into broader device purchases and equipment I do not currently need."
}
